label: EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY
title: Ideas become infrastructure.
description: The EEO Innovative Best Practices Grant Initiative connects investment, people, and practice to create lasting opportunity.

label: THE FOUNDATION · 2021
title: $20 million for statewide EEO progress.
description: AB 132 created a one-time EEO Best Practices Fund. Approximately $15.5 million was apportioned to eligible districts in 2021–22.

label: FIRST COMPETITIVE CYCLE · 2023–25
title: $5,651,806 awarded to 21 districts.
description: The Chancellor’s Office added funding to expand the first competitive EEO IBP award cycle.

label: CURRENT CYCLE · 2026–28
title: $1.4 million across 11 districts.
description: Awards of $100,000 and $150,000 support innovative pre-hiring, post-hiring, and EEO interventions.

label: COMPETITIVE AWARDS SINCE LAUNCH
title: $7,051,806 committed through two cycles.
description: Thirty-two district award selections turn statewide investment into local experimentation and shared learning.

label: ELEVEN LOCAL SIGNALS
title: Eleven districts. $1.4 million in motion.
description: Every current award, connected in one view.
transcript: Current awards are Allan Hancock Joint CCD, Antelope Valley CCD, Citrus CCD, Peralta CCD, and West Valley-Mission CCD at $100,000 each; and Kern CCD, Mt. San Antonio CCD, North Orange County CCD, San Diego CCD, Santa Monica CCD, and State Center CCD at $150,000 each.

label: SUSTAINABLE IMPACT MODEL
title: Investment that compounds.
description: Projects become tested practices. Practices build shared capacity. Capacity sustains systemwide progress.
transcript: The initiative connects investment, implementation, learning, and shared capacity to support lasting equal employment opportunity impact.
